Class AetherisStage2

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.AetherisStage2
public final class AetherisStage2 extends Object
The AetherisStage2 class holds the notebook rules the canvas shares. A pin search splits text into tokens and matches every token. A pipe replaces {{cell[k].output}} from an earlier cell. CONCAT joins member replies under a JOIN line. The version-1 exchange writes and reads a canvas as line text. // @aa-sdd S1-09 G-12 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

clayl (2026-10-20)

  • Method Details

    • pinTokens

      public static List<String> pinTokens(String raw)
      The method splits a pin field into tokens. A letter or digit stays in the current token. Any other character ends the token. Each token is stored in lower case. The words a, the, and, of, and to are dropped. A null field returns an empty list.
      Parameters:
      raw - The raw value is the pin field, and it may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the remaining tokens.

    • pinMatch

      public static boolean pinMatch(CellRecord cell, List<String> tokens)
      The method reports whether every pin token occurs in the cell text. A null cell returns false. An unreadable cell returns false. An ephemeral cell is not searched. A null or empty token list returns false. The search text is the user text, a newline, and the assistant text, in lower case. A missing token returns false. Every token present returns true.
      Parameters:
      cell - The cell is the row to search, and it may be null.
      tokens - The tokens are the pin tokens from pinTokens(String).
      Returns:
      The return value is true when every token occurs in the input or the output.

    • kept

      public static boolean kept(CellRecord cell)
      The method reports whether a cell stays in the source list. A null cell returns false. An unreadable cell returns false. CellState.EXCLUDED returns false. An ephemeral cell whose user text and assistant text are both blank returns false. Any other cell returns true.
      Parameters:
      cell - The cell is the row being considered, and it may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when the cell stays in the source list.

    • providerId

      public static String providerId(String target)
      The method returns the provider id from a stored execution target. A null target returns ollama. A blank target returns ollama. The id is the text before the first /. A target with no slash uses the whole trimmed target. The id is returned in lower case.
      Parameters:
      target - The target is the stored execution target, and it may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the provider id, and an empty target selects ollama.

    • joinWord

      private static String joinWord(CellRecord cell)
      The method returns the short model word used on a join line. An Ollama or Grok target uses the model id after the slash. An empty model id uses the provider id instead. A pool target uses the word pool. Any other provider uses shownTarget(CellRecord). A null cell uses shownTarget(CellRecord).

      Returns:

      private static boolean joinBannerLine(String line)
      The method reports whether one stored line is a join banner. The line must start with JOIN . The rest of the line must be non-empty. A space in the rest of the line returns false. A null line returns false.
      Parameters:
      line - The line is one stored line, and it may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when the line is a join banner.

    • concatJoin

      public static String concatJoin(List<CellRecord> members)
      The method joins member replies into one assistant text. Each part starts with JOIN and the short model word from joinWord(CellRecord). The assistant text of that member follows on the next line. A null assistant text is written as empty. Parts are separated by a blank line.
      Parameters:
      members - The members are the cells in send order.
      Returns:
      The return value is the merged assistant text.

    • stripJoinBanners

      public static String stripJoinBanners(String merged, List<CellRecord> members)
      The method drops the JOIN lines that concatJoin(List) writes. A null or empty merge returns empty. A line that joinBannerLine(String) accepts is dropped. A line equal to JOIN plus shownTarget(CellRecord) for a member is also dropped. Every other line stays, including the reply text. A null member list drops only the short-banner lines.
      Parameters:
      merged - The merged text is the stored merge reply, and it may be null.
      members - The members are the group cells in canvas order, and the list may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the reply text without those banners.

    • resolvePipes

      public static String resolvePipes(String text, List<CellRecord> kept)
      The method replaces {{cell[k].output}} from kept cells. k is 1-based. A failure string means the pipe does not send. The kept list is the source cells in send order, without the target cell.
      Parameters:
      text - The text is the prompt, and it may be null.
      kept - The kept list is those source cells.
      Returns:
      The return value is the resolved text, or a failure that starts with pipe:.

    • sourcesBefore

      public static List<CellRecord> sourcesBefore(List<CellRecord> ordered, CellRecord target, boolean cloud)
      The method collects source cells that sit before the target. The scan stops at the target id. A cell that kept(CellRecord) rejects is skipped. A cloud send also skips an ephemeral cell. A cell in the same non-empty group as the target is skipped.
      Parameters:
      ordered - The ordered list is the cells in send order.
      target - The target is the cell being sent, and it may be null.
      cloud - The flag is true when ephemeral text is omitted.
      Returns:
      The return value is the kept sources before the target.

    • exportToon

      public static String exportToon(String name, List<CellRecord> cells, boolean keepBurners)
      The method writes a version-1 canvas body. The first line is version: 1. The canvas name follows. Each cell writes its fields, including an empty group id. An ephemeral cell omits the user and assistant text unless keepBurners is true. A null state is written as INCLUDED.
      Parameters:
      name - The name is the canvas name.
      cells - The cells are the rows in send order.
      keepBurners - The flag is true when burner bodies stay in the file.
      Returns:
      The return value is the line text.

    • importToon

      public static List<CellRecord> importToon(String raw, String canvasId)
      The method imports a canvas as a copy. A body whose version is not 1 returns an empty list. Each cell id becomes a new UUID. Each non-empty group id becomes one new UUID shared by that group. A parent id is rewritten to the new id, or cleared when the parent is missing. A blank branch id becomes main. Pipe indexes in the text are rewritten to the new kept-cell order. A pipe whose old index has no new cell is left unchanged.
      Parameters:
      raw - The raw text is the file body.
      canvasId - The canvas id is the destination canvas.
      Returns:
      The return value is the copied cells, or empty when the version is not 1.

    • resolvePipes

      private static String resolvePipes(String text, List<CellRecord> kept, ArrayList<String> stack)
      The method replaces every {{cell[k].output}} in one text. A null text returns empty. Text with no pipe marker is copied through. A marker without a closing ].output} is copied through. A k that is not an integer returns pipe: bad k. A k below 1 or past the kept list returns pipe: bad k. An ephemeral source returns pipe: ephemeral. A source whose status is FAILED returns pipe: failed. An empty assistant text returns pipe: empty. A source already on the stack returns pipe: cycle. A nested failure is returned as that same failure string.
      Parameters:
      text - The text is the prompt or a nested assistant text, and it may be null.
      kept - The kept list is the source cells.
      stack - The stack holds source ids already being expanded.
      Returns:
      The return value is the resolved text, or a failure that starts with pipe:.

    • rewriteK

      private static String rewriteK(String text, HashMap<Integer,Integer> kMap)
      The method rewrites pipe indexes after an import copy. A null text returns empty. An empty text returns empty. A marker that is not an integer is copied unchanged. A k missing from the map is copied unchanged. A mapped k is written with the new index.
      Parameters:
      text - The text is the user or assistant text, and it may be null.
      kMap - The map sends an old 1-based index to the new 1-based index.
      Returns:
      The return value is the rewritten text.

    • parseExport

      private static ArrayList<CellRecord> parseExport(String raw)
      The method parses a version-1 export into cells. A null or empty body returns an empty list. A first line that does not start with version: returns an empty list. A version other than 1 returns an empty list. A line that starts with - id: begins a cell. That cell starts readable, included, and on branch main. A field line before the first id is ignored. context_state sets readable from CellState.knownToken(String) and the state from CellState.fromToken(String). A bad integer keeps the current turn index or stores column 0.
      Parameters:
      raw - The raw text is the file body, and it may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the parsed cells.

      The method reports whether two cells share a non-empty group id. A null cell returns false. A null target returns false. An empty group id returns false.

      target - The target is the cell being sent.

    • pushToken

      private static void pushToken(List<String> out, StringBuilder cur)
      The method stores one finished token and clears the buffer. An empty buffer does nothing. The token is stored in lower case. a, the, and, of, and to are not stored.
      Parameters:
      out - The list receives the token.
      cur - The buffer holds the characters gathered so far.

    • esc

      private static String esc(String raw)
      The method escapes one export field. A null value returns empty. A backslash becomes two backslashes. A newline becomes \\n. A carriage return is removed.
      Parameters:
      raw - The raw value is the field text, and it may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the escaped text.

      private static String unesc(String raw)
      The method reverses esc(String). A null value returns empty. \\n becomes a newline. A doubled backslash becomes one backslash.
      Parameters:
      raw - The raw value is the escaped field, and it may be null.
      Returns:
